summary: Round-3 review fixes: SFTP marker cap, SMB3 sealed credential removal on retirement, marker-safe unprotect, separate credential key that is never recreated on reads, stable member backoff classes, capacity warning on hard limits only, sliding push session, no plaintext SMB discovery file on disk. API impact: none; Core-internal.

guide.reason: Key location and limits, credential file removal, and capacity warning scope changed.

api.reason: No request or response shape changed; the capacity check keeps its name, and the push session only lives longer.

state.record: Credential key file backup-credential-key/key in the Core state directory and sealed SMB3 files under backup-smb-credentials; a fresh Controller holds neither.
state.reason: Secrets and their key stay on the host that uses them.

verification.method: Focused Go tests per fix, each confirmed red with go test -overlay against the old code; full go test ./... at the end.
verification.limits: Crash between rename-aside and restore of a protect marker, and real systemd-creds sealing or reboot remount, were not run.
